name: Alabama
local: Local occupational license taxes (e.g. Birmingham, Bessemer, Gadsden, some counties) apply only to wages/net business earnings, not to interest; no local tax reaches T-bill interest.
usInterest: Interest on U.S. obligations is exempt from Alabama income tax (excluded from Alabama gross income; reported as exempt interest on Form 40, Schedule B). Exact line not re-verified for 2026.
sourceTitle: Alabama Department of Revenue - FAQ: What is Alabama's Individual Income Tax Rate?
note: Statutory rates (Code of Ala. 40-18-5), not indexed and not year-specific; unchanged for 2026. Head of family and MFS use the single schedule. Alabama allows a deduction for federal income tax paid, which lowers the effective state rate; not modeled here.

name: Alaska
local: No local income taxes in Alaska (local governments levy sales/property taxes only).
usInterest: Not applicable: no individual income tax.
sourceTitle: Alaska Department of Revenue, Tax Division - Tax Programs
note: Alaska has no individual income tax (repealed 1980). Official page not re-fetched in this pass; status is long-standing.

name: Arizona
surtax: None for individuals in practice (the Prop 208 3.5% surcharge, A.R.S. 43-1013, was struck down by the courts).
local: Arizona cities and counties do not levy income taxes.
usInterest: Subtraction from Arizona gross income for interest on obligations of the United States, A.R.S. 43-1022(4) (Form 140 subtractions section). ADOR also lists 'interest from U.S. government obligations' as income Arizona does not tax.
sourceTitle: Arizona Department of Revenue - Form 140 Optional Tax Tables ('For tax year 2023 and beyond ... Arizona's flat tax rate of 2.5%')
note: Flat 2.5% for tax year 2023 and beyond per ADOR. Subtraction text read on https://www.azleg.gov/ars/43/01022.htm and ADOR individuals page https://azdor.gov/individual-income-tax-information.

name: Arkansas
local: No local income taxes in Arkansas.
usInterest: Interest on U.S. obligations is exempt from Arkansas income tax (not included in Arkansas income on AR1000F). Exact form line not verified.
sourceTitle: State of Arkansas Withholding Tax Formula Method, Tax Year 2026 (revised, top rate 3.70%)
note: Brackets are the 2026 DFA withholding formula brackets (net taxable income after the $2,470 standard deduction); the original Jan-2026 formula used 3.9% and was revised to 3.7% after 2026 legislation lowering the top rate retroactive to 2026-01-01. Arkansas has no separate joint schedule (each spouse computes on the same table), so joint = single. Above ~$94,700 of net income the 'minus adjustment' shrinks by $10 per $100 (a phase-out of the low brackets ending at $97,801), so marginal rate is briefly ~13.7% in that band and 3.7% above. The individual return tax tables for 2026 are not published yet; brackets taken from withholding formula.

name: California
surtax: Mental Health Services Tax: additional 1% on taxable income over $1,000,000 (all filing statuses), so top combined rate 13.3%.
local: No city/county income tax reaches interest (San Francisco and others tax payroll/gross receipts of businesses only).
usInterest: Interest on U.S. obligations (T-bills, notes, bonds) is subtracted on Schedule CA (540), Part I, Section B, line 2 (taxable interest), column B (subtractions). Line number from 2025 form layout, not re-verified.
sourceTitle: 2025 California Tax Rate Schedules (FTB, Form 540 Personal Income Tax Booklet 2025)
note: FTB has not yet published the 2026 indexed rate schedules (2026 page 404 as of 2026-10-19). The EDD 2026 Method B withholding schedules (https://edd.ca.gov/siteassets/files/pdf_pub_ctr/26methb.pdf) still use these same 2025 thresholds (rates x1.1). Thresholds will be inflation-indexed for 2026 later.

name: Colorado
surtax: None. (The 2022 Prop 121 rate is 4.4%; a temporary TABOR-triggered rate reduction under C.R.S. 39-22-627 can apply for a given year, e.g. 4.25% for 2024.)
local: Denver, Aurora, Glendale, Greenwood Village and Sheridan levy Occupational Privilege Taxes (fixed monthly amounts on employees/employers) - wages only, not interest.
usInterest: Subtraction for interest on U.S. government obligations included in federal taxable income, on Form DR 0104AD (Subtractions from Income Schedule), 'U.S. government interest' line; see FYI Income 20.
sourceTitle: DR 1098 - 2026 Colorado Withholding Worksheet for Employers (line 2c: multiply by 4.40%)
note: CDOR Individual Income Tax Guide (https://tax.colorado.gov/individual-income-tax-guide) lists rates through 2025 (4.4%); the 2026 withholding worksheet uses 4.40%. A temporary TABOR rate cut for 2026 cannot be ruled out until certified; none found.

name: Connecticut
surtax: No separate surtax, but the 2% bracket phases out (single: CT AGI over $56,500; joint threshold higher, not re-read) and benefit-recapture add-ons apply above CT AGI $105,000/$200,000/$500,000 single (higher thresholds for joint), raising the effective marginal rate in those ranges.
local: No local income taxes in Connecticut.
usInterest: Subtraction for interest on U.S. government obligations on Form CT-1040 Schedule 1 (modifications to federal AGI), C.G.S. 12-701(a)(20)(B). Exact line not re-verified.
sourceTitle: Connecticut General Statutes Chapter 229, Sec. 12-700(a)(10) - rates for taxable years commencing on or after January 1, 2024
note: Schedule in statute applies to 2024 and later; the 2026 Supplement (https://www.cga.ct.gov/2026/sup/chap_229.htm) does not amend Sec. 12-700. Joint phase-out threshold for the 2% bracket not re-read for joint filers (single = $56,500).

name: Delaware
local: City of Wilmington 1.25% earned income tax (wages and net profits only, not interest). No other local income taxes.
usInterest: Interest on obligations of the United States is subtracted from federal AGI on the Delaware resident return (PIT-RES additions/subtractions section), 30 Del. C. 1106(b). Exact line not re-verified.
sourceTitle: Delaware Code Title 30, Chapter 11, Subchapter I, Sec. 1102(a)(14) - taxable years beginning after December 31, 2013
note: Statutory schedule unchanged since 2014; same table for all filing statuses (married couples may file combined separate). HB 13 (153rd GA, proposing higher brackets above $125k/$150k) was not enacted per legis.delaware.gov (HS 2 still in committee).

name: District of Columbia
local: DC is a single jurisdiction; no separate local tax.
usInterest: Interest on U.S. obligations is subtracted on Form D-40, Schedule I (subtractions from federal AGI). Exact line not re-verified.
sourceTitle: DC Office of Tax and Revenue - DC Individual and Fiduciary Income Tax Rates (tax years beginning after 12/31/2021)
note: Same schedule for all filing statuses; not indexed.

name: Florida
usInterest: Not applicable: no individual income tax (intangible personal property tax repealed in 2007).
note: Florida Constitution Art. VII s.5 bars a personal income tax. Official page not re-fetched in this pass; status is long-standing.

name: Georgia
local: No local income taxes in Georgia.
usInterest: Subtraction for interest on U.S. obligations on Form 500, Schedule 1 (adjustments to income). Exact line not re-verified.
sourceTitle: Georgia Department of Revenue - Important Tax Updates ('The Georgia income tax rate has been reduced to a flat rate of 4.99%')
note: 2026 flat rate 4.99% (down from 5.19% in 2025) per GA DOR; 2026 standard deduction $15,000 single / $30,000 MFJ. Further scheduled cuts from 2027 per 2026 legislation (secondary sources).

name: Hawaii
local: No county income taxes in Hawaii.
usInterest: Interest on federal obligations (incl. Treasury bills and notes) is subtracted on Form N-11 line 18 (Other Hawaii subtractions), via line a of the Hawaii Subtractions Worksheet (2025 N-11 instructions).
sourceTitle: Hawaii Department of Taxation Announcement No. 2024-03 (Act 46, SLH 2024): 'For tax year 2026 ... The income tax brackets will be the same as in tax year 2025.'
note: 2025 brackets confirmed identical in the 2025 N-11 instructions (https://files.hawaii.gov/tax/forms/2025/n11ins.pdf). 2026 standard deduction $8,000 single / $16,000 joint. A 2026 act (SB 3125) adds a 13% rate over $1M starting tax year 2027, not 2026 (secondary source; not verified on capitol.hawaii.gov, which blocked access).

name: Idaho
local: No local income taxes in Idaho.
usInterest: Interest on U.S. government obligations is subtracted on Form 39R (Part B, subtractions from income). Exact line not re-verified.
sourceTitle: Idaho State Tax Commission - Individual Income Tax Rate Schedule (Year 2025: single 0% to $4,811, 5.3% from $4,812; married 0% to $9,622, 5.3% from $9,623)
note: tax.idaho.gov refused connections from this environment; page read via Wayback Machine capture of 2026-10-15 (page last updated 2025-12-29). The Tax Commission basics page says 'The income tax rate for 2025 is 5.3%'. No 2026 schedule published yet; 5.3% (HB 40, 2025) has no sunset, but 2026 zero-bracket thresholds will be inflation-indexed. No 2026 rate cut found.
